description: GET /v1/paymaster/deny-rules - senders and targets this merchant blocks from sponsorship. A deny rule is checked before the contract allowlist and wins: a matching sender or any call target is refused even when the target is allowlisted, and one denied call target refuses a whole batch (JSON-RPC -32600 "Policy denied: paymaster_blocked_by_merchant_rule"). Newest first, at most 500 items; "total" is the full count. Read-only.
name: paymaster_deny_rules_list
title: List paymaster deny rules
